prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement through a rugged, moss-covered landscape under a cloudy sky at sunset. The camera pans slightly upward, revealing towering rock formations silhouetted against an orange-hued sky, with thick clouds drifting slowly overhead. As the viewer progresses, the terrain shifts from dense patches of green moss to more barren, rocky areas, with scattered boulders and uneven ground. The camera angle adjusts to capture the expansive view of distant mountains shrouded in mist, emphasizing the vastness of the scene. The lighting gradually softens, casting long shadows across the landscape, enhancing the textures of the rocks and moss. The camera then focuses briefly on a map laid out on the ground, before continuing its journey, navigating through the rocky terrain with smooth, deliberate movements. The environment remains empty, with no signs of human presence, creating a serene and isolated atmosphere. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy tones, with the warm hues of the sunset contrasting against the cool grays and greens of the natural surroundings. The camera's steady pace and subtle movements provide a continuous, immersive experience of exploring this remote Icelandic landscape.
